ulirfendor_1.m: No! Stay away! You shall not defeat me!

ulirfendor_10.m: I have placed a blessing of the Shadow upon this small island here, so that I may work uninterrupted. Strangely enough, it seems to be very effective on them.

ulirfendor_11.m: They seem to be very cautious about it. So far, not even one has dared to approach me. Even those pesky lizards are keeping their distance.
r: What have you translated from the shrine so far?

ulirfendor_12.m: It speaks of Kazaul and of the misery that comes to anyone that opposes the will of Kazaul.

ulirfendor_13.m: Something about 're-birth from within the followers'. Not sure I have translated that part correctly, but I think that is what it says. Definitely something about re-birth or birth.

ulirfendor_14.m: It also speaks of someone or some ... thing called the 'Dark protector'. Most parts of the text for that is missing from the shrine however.

ulirfendor_15.m: Whatever it means, it seems important. It is also obvious that the 'Dark protector' brings power to Kazaul, and misery to any opposition.

ulirfendor_16.m: Regardless, it must be stopped, whatever it means. Maybe it refers to something deeper down this cave? I have not ventured further into the cave to the east since I could not get past those ... things.

ulirfendor_17.m: Forgive me, I must continue translating the few readable parts left on this shrine.
r: Would you like any help with that?

ulirfendor_18.m: Hmm, maybe. I need to figure out what this last part should be. Hmm...

ulirfendor_19.m: The last part of this piece has been eroded from the rock. It begins with 'Kulauil hamar urum Kazaul'te'. But what is the rest of that?

ulirfendor_19_2.m: Argh, if this cave wasn't so damp, I bet the rest of the text would still be there.
r: I could go look for other clues about the missing parts if you want?

ulirfendor_2.m: Oh wait, you are not one of them. You ... you are not one of those spawns.
r: Relax, I am not here to hurt you.

ulirfendor_21.m: I have looked thoroughly for any clues in the western part of this cave, but have not found any. I have not entered the eastern parts of the cave however.

ulirfendor_22.m: Also, I should warn you that I believe the shrine talks of a powerful creature somewhere in this cave. Maybe if you find that creature, it will provide some clue as to what the missing parts are? You need to be careful though.
r: I will go look in the eastern parts of the cave then.

ulirfendor_4.m: Oh, how long have I been down here? I can't remember.

ulirfendor_5.m: No matter. I must finish my work here. You see this shrine here?

ulirfendor_5_1.m: If my understanding is correct, this shrine is a remnant of Kazaul.

ulirfendor_6.m: The writings on it have almost vanished, but I have managed to read parts of it. It speaks in an ancient Kazaul tongue, so all parts are not clear to me.

ulirfendor_7.m: I am sure that this shrine is part of the cause for these ... these ... things ... that lurk in this cave. I will do anything in my power to defeat whatever mischief that comes from it.
r: How come these creatures do not attack you?
What have you translated so far?

ulirfendor_8.m: Ah, the allaceph. I had not seen one for many years until I entered this cave. They are a remnant of the guardians of Kazaul.

ulirfendor_9.m: Have you noticed how they seem to feed upon whoever tries to fight them? Cursed things, almost got a hold of me, they did.
r: How come these creatures do not attack you?
What have you translated from the shrine so far?

ulirfendor_cured_1.m: I am glad to see that you are looking better than before. I assume you got the help you needed from Talion in Loneford?
r: Yes, Talion cured me of that thing.

ulirfendor_cured_2.m: That's good to hear. I hope that ... thing ... didn't have any permanent side-effects on you.
r: I defeated the lich in the depths of the eastern cave.
I found a strange looking helmet among the remains of that lich. Do you know anything about it?

ulirfendor_decline.m: No matter, I will find out myself then. Thank you for your help so far. Goodbye.

ulirfendor_demon_1.m: Yes, you told me that you killed the lich. Excellent work.

ulirfendor_demon_2.m: The people of the surrounding towns will have you to thank.
r: I found a strange looking helmet among the remains of that lich. Do you know anything about it?

ulirfendor_demon_d1.m: Oh, that is good news indeed. A lich you say? With your help, the people of the surrounding towns should be safe from whatever mischief the lich could have caused now.

ulirfendor_demon_d2.m: Thank you so much for your help!

ulirfendor_dp_bless_1.m: You truly have a large heart.

ulirfendor_dp_bless_2.m: The blessing will grant you the aid of the Shadow while in combat, protecting you from harmful effects that your opponent might inflict upon you.
r: Thank you, but that will not be necessary. I am just happy to help.

ulirfendor_dp_bless_3.m: Very well, I will give you the dark blessing of the Shadow.

ulirfendor_dp_bless_4.m: [Ulirfendor starts chanting in a tongue that you do not recognize]

ulirfendor_dp_bless_5.m: There. You now have the dark blessing of the Shadow upon you.

ulirfendor_dp_bless_6.m: Thank you yet again for all you have done here.

ulirfendor_dp_proc_10.m: Now, watch this. I love this part.

ulirfendor_dp_proc_11.m: [Ulirfendor takes aim with his foot and stomps the helmet with the heel of his boot in a powerful motion]

ulirfendor_dp_proc_12.m: [The helmet completely shatters, leaving nothing but a fine dust]

ulirfendor_dp_proc_14.m: [He does the same with the heart that also seems to have completely frozen and gotten covered with cracks]

ulirfendor_dp_proc_16.m: You, my friend, have done a great deed here today. This thing would have brought great misery if it would have fallen into the wrong hands.

ulirfendor_dp_proc_17.m: The people of the surrounding towns are now safe from whatever misery that helmet would have brought. All thanks to you!

ulirfendor_dp_proc_18.m: As a token of my appreciation, I am willing to grant upon you a blessing of the Shadow.
r: Thank you, but that will not be necessary. I am just happy to help.

ulirfendor_dp_proc_2.m: Excellent. I will begin the procedure immediately.

ulirfendor_dp_proc_3.m: [Ulirfendor places the helmet and the lich's heart on the ground before him, and opens his backpack of items]

ulirfendor_dp_proc_4.m: [He pulls out a leathery potion case from his backpack, and takes out a vial of clear but almost shining liquid]

ulirfendor_dp_proc_5.m: [Ulirfendor pours the contents of the vial on the helmet and the heart in circling motions, taking good care to not spill any on the ground]

ulirfendor_dp_proc_6.m: It should be as simple as that really. Powerful stuff this.

ulirfendor_dp_proc_7.m: [The surface of the helmet seems to freeze, almost like it had a layer of ice on it]

ulirfendor_dp_proc_8.m: [After a while, small cracks appear on the surface, making tiny sounds as they appear]

ulirfendor_dp_proc_9.m: [The cracks start to get larger and more dense along the surface, until the helmet is completely covered by them]

ulirfendor_dp_return1.m: Hello again. Have you made up your mind about what we talked about before?
r: What was that about destroying the helmet?
Can you tell me again what you think about this helmet?

ulirfendor_findparts_1.m: Hello again. Did you find any clues about what the missing parts are?
r: No, I have not found any clues yet.
Can you tell me again what you have translated from the shrine?
Yes, I encountered a creature to the east that spoke the words you told me.

ulirfendor_findparts_10.m: Hello again. Did you speak those words to the creature you encountered?
r: What was I supposed to do again?
Can you repeat the words I was supposed to speak to the guardian?
No, not yet. But I am working on it.

ulirfendor_findparts_13.m: Well, you should probably investigate that area some more. I am sure there are more clues in there about what this shrine speaks of.

ulirfendor_findparts_2.m: If you really want to help, then please go look for any other clues you might find.

ulirfendor_findparts_3.m: Oh good, tell me, did you find any more clues?
r: Yes, the creature also spoke the words 'Kazaul hamat urul', maybe that is part of the missing piece?

ulirfendor_findparts_4.m: Hmm ... 'hamat urul' ... yes of course! That's what it says on the eroded parts of the shrine!

ulirfendor_findparts_5.m: Excellent work my friend! Now I just need to translate it.

ulirfendor_findparts_6.m: I wonder what this whole piece means. 'Kulauil hamar urum Kazaul'te. Kazaul hamat urul' - that's the part you heard the creature speak.

ulirfendor_findparts_7.m: The next part is 'Klatam ur turum Kazaul'te', and I am not sure what that means. Something about handing over some item?

ulirfendor_findparts_8.m: Maybe the creature you encountered responds to that phrase if you speak to it? If you want to help, you could go and try speaking that phrase to it.
r: Sure, I will go speak those words to the creature.
Whatever, I'll do it, but I hope this is the last time that I have to run back and forth!
No way, I have helped you enough now.
I had better not get involved in this.

ulirfendor_findparts_9.m: Good. Please return as soon as possible.

ulirfendor_helmet_1.m: Could it be? Hmm. Let me look at that thing.

ulirfendor_helmet_2.m: Those markings on it are most peculiar. It was found by the lich that you spoke of?

ulirfendor_helmet_3.m: Hmm. You know what, this could actually be connected to what the shrine speaks of - The Dark Protector.

ulirfendor_helmet_4.m: I am not certain of what the term 'The Dark Protector' refers to. At first I thought it might be some creature protecting something, but this helmet seems to better fit what the shrine speaks of.

ulirfendor_helmet_5.m: It could either be the helmet itself, or that the helmet has some effect on whoever wears it, meaning that the wearer will become the Dark Protector.

ulirfendor_helmet_6.m: Nevertheless, I am almost certain that this artifact is connected to what this shrine speaks of, and that the artifact is rich with Kazaul influence.

ulirfendor_helmet_7.m: As such, it would most certainly bring misery to the surroundings of whoever carries it. Directly or indirectly, I do not know.

ulirfendor_helmet_8.m: I say, we must destroy that item immediately to make sure that the Kazaul taint is forever cleansed from this place and to make sure it does not fall into the wrong hands.
r: He he, a powerful item you say? How much would you think it is worth?
What should we do in order to destroy it?
Absolutely. I will do anything to protect the people from this thing.
Interesting. How powerful could someone become by wearing this thing?

ulirfendor_helmet_d1.m: That is most interesting, but you seem to have more pressing matters to attend to.

ulirfendor_helmet_keep1.m: What!? Keep it!? Have you gone mad? We need to destroy it to protect the people!
r: Who knows what power I could gain from it? I will keep this for myself.
It could be worth a lot. I will keep this for myself.
I think I should give this a second thought before we begin.

ulirfendor_helmet_keep2.m: What is this!? I knew there was something wrong about you the first time I saw you.

ulirfendor_helmet_keep3.m: By the Shadow, I will stop you. Whatever it takes. You will not live to see the next day!

ulirfendor_helmet_n2.m: To destroy it, I think it will suffice to use what we normally use when removing the taint of Kazaul - a vial of purifying spirit.

ulirfendor_helmet_n3.m: Fortunately, I always carry some on me, so that won't be a problem.

ulirfendor_helmet_n4.m: What could be a problem however, is the other thing we will need. This artifact is most likely connected to that lich you encountered.

ulirfendor_helmet_n5.m: We would need to use the vial of purifying spirit on something powerful from that lich as well.
r: I managed to get the heart of the lich, would that do?

ulirfendor_helmet_n6.m: The heart? Oh yes, that would surely do.

ulirfendor_helmet_n7.m: Quickly now, give me the helmet and the heart of the lich, and I will begin the procedure.
r: Here is the helmet and the heart.
I think I should give this a second thought before we begin.
No. I will keep this item for myself instead.

ulirfendor_helmet_n8.m: Think all you want, but please hurry. We need to destroy this thing as soon as possible!

ulirfendor_helmet_power.m: I don't even want to think about that. It would surely bring misery to the surroundings of whoever wears it. We must destroy it immediately!
r: He he, sounds powerful. How much would you think it is worth?
What should we do in order to destroy it?
No. I will keep this item for myself instead.

ulirfendor_helmet_worth.m: Worth!? What difference would that make? We need to destroy it immediately!
r: How powerful could someone become by wearing this thing?
What should we do in order to destroy it?
No. I will keep this item for myself instead.

ulirfendor_infected_10.m: No ... can it be? Are they actually real?

ulirfendor_infected_11.m: You show all the signs. If this is true, then you are in great danger.

ulirfendor_infected_12.m: Long ago, I read a book on Kazaul rituals. The first part of one particular ritual I read about talks about 'the carrier', that supposedly is infected with Kazaul rotworms.

ulirfendor_infected_13.m: The Kazaul rotworms need a living being to feed upon, before their eggs can hatch. Their eggs can slowly kill a person from the inside, and the worms themselves cause the carrier to become weak during the whole process.

ulirfendor_infected_14.m: The ritual proceeds with the carrier being eaten from the inside by the rotworms and their eggs, in effect, giving birth to the creatures within. Also, the process can have ... shall we say ... unusual effects on the carrier before that.

ulirfendor_infected_15.m: Needless to say, you are in great danger, and you should seek help immediately.

ulirfendor_infected_17.m: You should hurry and seek help from one of the priests of the Shadow as quickly as possible. My dear friend Talion in the temple of Loneford should be able to help you.

ulirfendor_infected_18.m: Seek him out immediately. Hurry! You might not have much time.
r: OK, I will go to Talion in the Loneford temple at once. Goodbye.

ulirfendor_infected_19.m: I should also tell you that it is of great importance that you first destroy whatever creature that infected you with this.
r: OK, I will defeat the lich first. Goodbye.
I defeated the lich in the depths of the eastern cave.

ulirfendor_infected_2.m: You are back! Please tell me you are well! Please tell me nothing happened to you!

ulirfendor_infected_3.m: I managed to translate the piece that we spoke about. Oh, what have I done. Please, tell me you are well!
r: No, I am not well. My stomach is turning and I feel weaker than usual. I encountered a lich down there that did something to me.

ulirfendor_infected_5.m: You see, while you were away, I managed to translate the words that we spoke about before.

ulirfendor_infected_6.m: The part that the creature spoke basically means 'No offering is worthy for Kazaul'.

ulirfendor_infected_7.m: Furthermore, the last part, that I made you speak to the creature, 'Klatam ur turum Kazaul'te', means 'My body for Kazaul'.

ulirfendor_infected_8.m: Oh, what have I done? I made you say it, and now you are touched by its vile essence.
r: It's not that bad. I have had worse.
What can I do to get rid of this affliction?
You better have a plan for how you should repay me for this trickery!
I at least defeated the lich that infected me with this thing.
I found a strange looking helmet among the remains of the lich that I defeated. Do you know anything about it?

ulirfendor_infected_9.m: Let me have a look at you.

maggots.10: Deep inside a cavern, I encountered a lich of Kazaul. Somehow the lich managed to infect me with things that crawl around in my stomach! I must find some way to get rid of these things inside of me. I should go talk to Ulirfendor, or seek help in one of the chapels.
maggots.20: Ulirfendor tells me that he read something long ago about rotworms that feed upon living tissue. They can have what he called 'unusual' effects on whoever carries them, and their eggs can slowly kill a person from the inside. I should seek help immediately, before it is too late.
maggots.21: Ulirfendor says that one of the priests of the Shadow should be able help me. I should go visit Talion at the chapel in Loneford at once.
maggots.30: Talion in Loneford told me that in order to be cured of my affliction, I will need to bring four parts to him. The parts that I will need are five bones, two pieces of animal hair, one irdegh poison gland and one empty vial. Bones and fur can probably be found on some animal in the wilderness, and the poison gland can be found on one of the irdeghs that have been spotted to the east.
maggots.40: I have brought the five bones to Talion.
maggots.41: I have brought the two pieces of animal hair to Talion.
maggots.42: I have brought one irdegh poison gland to Talion.
maggots.43: I have brought an empty vial to Talion.
maggots.45: I have now brought all pieces that Talion needs in order to cure me of these things.
maggots.50: Talion has cured me of the Kazaul rotworms. I managed to get one of the rotworms into an empty vial, and Talion told me that it would be very valuable. I cannot imagine for what.
maggots.51: Because of my former affliction, Talion has agreed to help me by placing blessings of the Shadow upon me whenever I wish, for a fee.

toszylae.10: On the road between Loneford and Brimhaven, I found a dried up lake-bed with a major cavern below. Deep inside the cavern, I met Ulirfendor - a priest of the Shadow from Brimhaven. Ulirfendor is trying to translate the inscriptions on a shrine of Kazaul, and has determined that it speaks of the 'Dark protector', but he is unsure what that refers to. Whatever it means, he is determined that it must be stopped.
toszylae.11: Ulirfendor needs help with figuring out what some of the missing parts on the shrine says. The inscription reads 'Kulauil hamar urum Kazaul'te', but the next parts have been completely eroded from the rock.
toszylae.15: I have agreed to help Ulirfendor find out what the missing parts of the inscription might be. Ulirfendor believes the shrine speaks of a powerful creature that lives deeper inside the dungeon. Maybe that could provide some clue as to what the missing parts are.
toszylae.20: Deep inside the dungeon, I encountered a radiant guardian, guarding some other being. The guardian uttered the phrases 'Kulauil hamar urum Kazaul'te. Kazaul hamat urul'. This must be what Ulirfendor was looking for. I should return to him at once.
toszylae.21: I tried to attack the guardian, but was unable to even reach it. Some powerful force held me back. Maybe Ulirfendor knows more.
toszylae.30: Ulirfendor was very pleased to hear that I uncovered the missing parts of the inscription.
toszylae.32: He also told me the continuation of the inscription, but did not know what it means. I should go back to the guardian and speak the words that Ulirfendor told me.
toszylae.42: I have spoken the words to the guardian.
toszylae.45: The guardian gave off a chilling laughter, and started attacking me.
toszylae.50: I defeated the guardian and reached the lich 'Toszylae'. The lich managed to infect me with something. I must kill the lich and return to Ulirfendor.
toszylae.60: Ulirfendor told me that he had managed to translate the parts of the inscription that I told the guardian. Apparently, what I told the guardian roughly means 'My body for Kazaul'. Ulirfendor was very concerned about what this means for me, and was very regretful that he had made me speak the words.
toszylae.70: Ulirfendor was very happy to hear that I managed to defeat the lich. With the lich defeated, the people in the surrounding areas should be safe now.

darkprotector.10: I have found a strange looking helmet from the lich 'Toszylae' that I defeated. I should go ask Ulirfendor if he knows anything about it.
darkprotector.15: Ulirfendor in the same dungeon thinks this artifact is what the shrine speaks of, and that it will bring misery to the surroundings of whoever carries it. He wants me to help him destroy it immediately.
darkprotector.26: To destroy the artifact, I would need give the helmet and the heart of the lich to Ulirfendor.
darkprotector.30: I have given the helmet to Ulirfendor.
darkprotector.31: I have given the heart of the lich to Ulirfendor.
darkprotector.35: Ulirfendor has destroyed the artifact. The people of the surrounding towns are safe from whatever misery the helmet would have brought.
darkprotector.40: For helping with both the lich and the helmet, Ulirfendor has given me the dark blessing of the Shadow.
darkprotector.41: For helping with both the lich and the helmet, Ulirfendor wanted to give me the dark blessing of the Shadow, but I declined.
darkprotector.50: I have decided to keep the helmet for myself. Who knows what power I could gain from it.
darkprotector.51: Ulirfendor attacked me for keeping the helmet.
darkprotector.55: I found a book by the shrine where Ulirfendor was. The book talks of a ritual that would restore the helmet to its true power. I should complete the ritual by the shrine if I want to use the helmet.
darkprotector.60: I have started the Kazaul ritual.
darkprotector.65: I have placed the helmet in front of the Kazaul shrine.
darkprotector.66: I have placed the lich's heart in front of the Kazaul shrine.
darkprotector.70: The ritual is complete, and I have restored the power of the helmet to its former glory.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
